source: Explicit user review of the portrait catalog
difficultPortraitPolicy: Record the limitation and continue to the next canonical face. Do not spend repeated generations trying to force the standard six-emotion treatment.
familyPolicy: Generate an uncovered canonical face first. Find hooded counterparts through visible face regions, including lower-face pixels outside shadow. Candidate matches require full intended mask/occlusion checks before reuse; preserve each derivative's original hood and shadows.

entries.reason: No visible mouth; animate eyes only.
Finger near the mouth complicates lip animation. Skip for the initial rollout.
Only eyes need animation; keep the remaining portrait unchanged.
Special geometry. Later consider eyes plus a simple opening/closing mouth; skip the standard viseme rollout initially.
No eyes. A limited portrait-specific attempt is optional; do not invent eyes or force blink/emotion frames.
Dark, blurry face. Try only if the source supports a convincing limited animation; otherwise defer.
Consider a subtle looping eye sparkle rather than the standard eyes/mouth/emotion pipeline.
User identifies this as a placeholder. Do not generate animation.
